name: IDEA WILD equipment grants
summary: Small grants of field equipment, and occasionally field funds, to individual researchers, educators and conservationists working on practice-based biodiversity conservation, with priority for countries with fewer resources.
reporting: After the project, recipients send follow-up materials on how the equipment was used, such as a short project summary, results and photos; there is no fixed format or deadline.

status.quote: IDEA WILD Is Currently Accepting Applications From ALL Countries

applicant_types.quote: Any individual can apply: IDEA WILD does not directly fund organizations.

geography.quote: IDEA WILD Is Currently Accepting Applications From ALL Countries

access.quote: Fill out the online application to apply for equipment support

window.quote: Applications are received on a rolling basis, meaning you can apply at any time while applications are open.

amount.quote: The total cost of your requested equipment must be less than $1500 U.S.

reporting.quote: Once an approved project is completed, each recipient is expected to submit follow-up materials to report on how the equipment was used.
